tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search Avahit's catalog of direct-to-consumer brand products whose prices Avahit re-checks at the store every day. Returns title, current price with the date of the last check, store domain, store rating and a link to the product page on Avahit.

tools.name: compare_alternatives
tools.description: Given an Avahit product id, return ranked alternatives with a match percentage explaining how close each one is (same category, price distance, product type, same store).

tools.name: get_store_sales
tools.description: When does a brand store have sales? Given a store domain or brand name (e.g. 'glossier.com', 'Boll & Branch'), return the sales it announced on its homepage or by email to newsletter subscribers with dates, whether product prices actually dropped in each (or the discount came off at checkout), price

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Given an Avahit product id, return what Avahit itself observed about its price: current price and when it was last verified against the store, the lowest and highest price seen with dates, the average, how many checks and since when. Amazon products have no history — Amazon's license forbids keeping

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_store_sales · Public sink: get_store_sales.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_store_sales · Public sink: get_store_sales

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
